releases.name: Bony Bones Adventures
releases.summary: Bony Bones Adventures is an action 3D platformer where you have to go through the path of an ordinary skeleton who challenged the invaders. Complete quests, look for ancestors equipment, fight enemies, and defeat bosses.

releases.name: Grave Of Voices
releases.summary: Ryan Morgan, a 21-year-old horror vlogger, thought he had found the perfect lead for his next video. But when he enters Ashfall, a town erased from the map, he realizes he's trapped in the catacombs below. To escape, he must solve puzzles, scavenge, hide from inhuman creatures, and fight to survive.

releases.name: Catventure
releases.summary: Catventure is a cozy and relaxing idle game that can sit at the bottom of your screen (or anywhere else), allowing you to enjoy a peaceful adventure during work or a busy day.

releases.name: Corporate Slave: Quiet Quitting
releases.summary: Are You Man Enough? Markets are hitting all-time highs, and you’re probably already set for early retirement. Good for you! But do you ever wonder what it’s like in the trenches? For less than the price of half a sandwich, you can watch them dodge the flying debris of soul-crushing workloads!

releases.name: Prison Break: Thirty Walls
releases.summary: Multi-Control modes to choseGame IntroductionMetal Force 2012 is a masterpiece of horizontal reel shot puzzle games made by Oye Faction. It was set in the end of year 2012 when all kinds of ghosts and demons living in the Third World wantonly attack the earth, plunder resources, control all the creatures and do all the evil things…..The earth is almost on the edge of extinction. The hero in this game has the responsibility of saving the earth, so he has to sneak into enemy’s home base and fight with them all by himself. More missions, more enemies, more dangers, and more fighting……All of these are waiting for our hero. Game Feature1.A masterpiece of horizontal reel shot puzzle games. 2.There are 5 stages and in each of them there are several small levels, having strong connection with each other and the difficulty increased one after another. 3.Two modes are available: Normal Mode and Hard Mode. When you choose hard mode you’d face much crueler challenges. 4.According to different combat scenes and players’ habits, different kinds of weapons are available, such as pistols, rifles, rocket launchers, grenades and sabers. 5.Differ from the traditional gaming operation modes, our innovative handling method is perfectly fit for the features of the mobile terminal. 6.For the delicate design of the pictures, the perfect action effects, the awesome sound and beautiful music, it’s a trip during the time you play Metal Slug 2012. 7.Up to 5 user accounts are supported. 8.Animated game tutorial is available.

releases.name: PanzerCity
releases.summary: A third-person arcade tank shooter. destroy endless waves of enemy tanks, gear up with gold, and defend your base alone or with up to 4 players in co-op.

releases.name: AutoChart
releases.summary: AutoChart is a key-based rhythm game powered by your own music. Import an audio or video file and let AI generate a note chart. Choose your difficulty and a 4–8 key layout, hit the falling notes to the beat, and chase your personal best.

releases.name: Panos
releases.summary: A casual tactical strategy game where you investigate Region 412, uncover secrets, fight seven powerful factions, and make choices that shape the story and lead to multiple endings.

releases.name: MOUSE: The House Always Wins
releases.summary:
Mouse is an asymmetrical multiplayer horror game where four survivors must stay alive while being hunted by a ruthless killer.

Behind the world's elite exists a secret organization known only as the House. Hidden from the public eye, the rich and powerful gather to participate in a deadly game called Mouse.

What appears innocent by name is anything but. Wealthy participants place bets on killers supplied by the House, while others choose to enter the hunt themselves, driven by curiosity, power, and the thrill of taking a life.

As a survivor, your goal is simple: stay alive until the timer runs out.

As the killer, your objective is to hunt down and eliminate every survivor before the game ends.

releases.name: Orbit Breaker (RedSabreTooth)
releases.summary: One button. One orbit. Don't die. Reverse your ship around the core to dodge incoming debris, grab gold for combo score, and climb your scoreboard. A pure, instant arcade reflex game - one run takes seconds, walking away takes longer.

releases.name: SightSplice
releases.summary: Fire the beam and beat the enemies!

releases.name: Co-create Stories
releases.summary:
Create the character you want and live your own adventure.

Co-create Stories is a single-player AI text RPG where every line and action is entered in your own words. The AI game master responds to what you try and continues the story.

Bribe a guard to enter through the back gate. Fight, flee, persuade, betray, or try something no fixed menu could predict. Every adventure unfolds differently.

releases.name: Parkour Obby: Food Escape
releases.summary:
Parkour Obby: Food Escape is a fast-paced obstacle course where every level is made out of delicious food. Jump across giant burgers and parkour your way to the finish!

FEATURES:
>Food-themed parkour levels
>Checkpoints to help you keep progressing
>Hardcore Mode with all checkpoints disabled
>Challenging obstacles and levels

releases.name: Save The President
releases.summary:
The bodyguard has only a few seconds to save the most important man in the world. Does he have what it takes?

Suit up, put on your sunglasses, and get ready for the most stressful job on the planet! In Save The President, you are a bodyguard tasked with protecting the President from imminent threats during public speeches and official events.

But be careful: react too soon and you could cause a national scandal. Hesitate for even a second, and the consequences could be fatal!

When a gunman’s laser sight appears in the crowd, the clock starts ticking. You’ll have only seconds to make the right move: leap heroically toward the podium, neutralize the gunman hiding in the crowd, or put yourself directly in the line of fire and take the bullet to save the President.

The future of the nation depends on your reflexes.

Save the President at any cost!

releases.name: Bloodspill
releases.summary: Bloodspill is a fast-paced, PvP retro FPS with one hit combat, featuring classic game modes like Deathmatch, Capture the Flag and Conquest

releases.name: Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve
releases.summary:
Step into the cockpit and take flight as an elite pilot across stunning skies. Enter intense dogfights, eliminate threats, and rise through gripping missions to earn your wings.

Campaign Mode showcases stunning visuals with dynamic multi-layered cloudscapes that capture the majesty of living skies. Feel the rush of a fast-paced arcade-style gameplay and deploy powerful weapons to dominate the battlefield.

Beyond the chaos in the air, breathtaking first-person scenes reveal your pilot’s story through breathtaking cinematics. Experience the pressure of command, the weight of decisions, and the bonds forged in battle. Between missions, bond with your squad members, rise to meet adversity, and prove yourself as a true ace.

releases.name: Let's Tidy Up! : Treasure
releases.summary: Treasure Trove is an organizing simulator about tidying up a Dwarf treasure room. Sort, stack and shelve 8,888 unique items to unlock new skills and abilities. Clear away mountains of gold and jewels as you begin to uncover the secrets that lie beneath...

releases.name: Saldyr: Before the Crown Fell
releases.summary: A 2D tactical RPG set in an empire on the brink. Lead your soldiers, exploit weapon matchups and break enemy morale. Eight chapters, solo or in co-op for two to three, with different endings shaped by the battles. Play in English, French or Italian.

releases.name: Obstacle Overdrive
releases.summary: Cruise through a world of colorful retro inspired toys in Obstacle Overdrive, a cozy off-roading toy car adventure! Navigate fun, challenging courses, tumultuous tumbles, and enjoy the charm of a miniature world where the obstacles are as playful as the ride itself.

releases.name: Crack the Pack
releases.summary: Open booster packs, buy upgrades, and collect over 1001 cards and their variants. Build a true automated booster factory by endlessly multiplying production until you unlock cloning and nuclear fusion !

releases.name: DUAL PROTOCOL: The Case of Eva & Miles
releases.summary: Play as Agent Eva to follow the trail, or as Analyst Miles to manage the operation. Dual Protocol is an asymmetric noir puzzle game where two players progress only through conversation. Without seeing each other’s screens, combine the data you have and uncover the truth behind the Castellari murder.

releases.name: Rorasuketo
releases.summary: A story-based casual JRPG inspired by sports manga, roller derby, and the Super Nintendo. Explore a fun world, make friends, and skate your heart out!

releases.name: Expat Manager
releases.summary: Run your own expat agency, process client requests, review documents, manage visa applications, and keep track of deadlines. Make important decisions, grow your business, and help people start a new life abroad.

releases.name: Game Keeper: Somebody Messed Up My Shop!
releases.summary: Game Keeper: Somebody Messed Up My Shop! is a single-player organizing game set in a chaotic video game store. Sort 4,290 cases by genre and order, fill 96 racks, progress and unlock powerful abilities, and complete 650 parody-filled series - with questionable help from Jeff, the coolest cat ever.
